messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick sync 1: we're rolling out a new "Policy Acknowledgement" flow to replace the old checkbox in the onboarding portal. Goals: explicit ack for handbook sections + automated tracking. Due: EOD Jun 4.

sam (People Ops): New flow summary: short ack per handbook section (Benefits, Data, Code of Conduct) + optional short quiz for Data. Completion flags feed HRIS.

cody (HRIS): If we wire completion flags into HRIS, send me the field mapping. I need: user_id, section_id, ack_ts, quiz_score, source (onboard/refresh).

maya (Recruiting): For offers: do we want new hires to ack before first day or within first 7 days? Which will be enforced?

anya (People Ops): Prefer within first 7 days. We'll make "Data Handling" ack required before requesting infra access. That will be an automated gate in the access request form.

jules (Eng): Heads-up: gating infra access could block new hires if the ack email lands in spam. Can we add a grace period for infra owners to approve access manually for special cases?

legal (Legal): From legal POV, we want explicit opt-in wording for the benefits section; Sam, please attach the final phrasing. I'll sign off on the ack language before it goes live.

sam (People Ops): Draft ack text (short): "I have read and understand Redwood's Data Handling, Benefits, and Code of Conduct sections. I agree to follow these policies." I'll post the PR in the handbook repo after legal review.

cody (HRIS): I'll add a nightly sync job once the schema is final. Can hr-bot drop a CSV to /internal/hr/exports/policy_ack_{date}.csv?

hr-bot: Scheduled export created: /internal/hr/exports/policy_ack_2026-06-05.csv next run 2026-06-05T03:00Z :robot_face:

maya (Recruiting): Also: recruiters need a short sentence to add to offer emails. Proposal: "Please complete the Policy Acknowledgement within your first 7 days; some access requests depend on it." Thoughts?

anya (People Ops): That works. Add a short blurb about who to contact for exceptions (people-ops@redwood.com).

jules (Eng): For managers: can we get a weekly missing-completions digest? One list per manager with direct reports outstanding.

cody (HRIS): Yes, I can generate a per-manager CSV. But I need managers to be identified in the HRIS manager_id field for everyone.

sam (People Ops): We'll publish manager reminder dates: reminder 1 on May 28, final nudge Jun 3. Template (manager DM): "Reminder: your directs must ack the updated handbook sections by Jun 4. Check tracker: <link>. Contact people-ops for exceptions."

legal (Legal): FYI: we'll require a separate ack for any employees handling regulated data; sam, let's add a checkbox that surfaces only for those groups.

anya (People Ops): Good call. We'll scope that by team tag in HRIS. Cody, can we have HRIS pass a reg_data_flag so the UI shows the extra checkbox?

cody (HRIS): Yep, add reg_data_flag to the export schema and I'll include it in the nightly sync.

hr-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by hr-bot

sam (People Ops): Last item: training tie-in. We're bundling a 15-min "Data Handling" micro-training for anyone who fails the quick quiz twice. QA path: three attempts allowed then manager follow-up.

maya (Recruiting): Makes sense. For contractors, do we treat them the same or require vendor confirmation?

anya (People Ops): Contractors must ack. For vendor-managed contractors, ask vendor to confirm completion or provide contract exception ID. We'll keep an exceptions CSV.

jules (Eng): Ok, I'll flag new hires on my team to complete the ack in their first 48 hours.

anya (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post the handbook PR link once legal approves the language and follow up with a status update on May 30."
